PATHWAY 1 ADVANCED REACTOR DEMONSTRATIONS (DEMOS) AWARD TO X ENERGY, LLC

THIS PROGRAM IS INTENDED TO FACILITATE THE DEVELOPMENT OF U.S. PRIVATE INDUSTRY ADVANCED NUCLEAR REACTOR 
DEMONSTRATIONS. IT WILL PROVIDE FUNDING FOR SEVERAL ADVANCED REACTORS THAT ARE RELIABLE, COST EFFECTIVE, LICENSABLE, 
AND COMMERCIALLY VIABLE. THESE DESIGNS ARE EXPECTED TO ENABLE A MARKET ENVIRONMENT IN WHICH COMMERCIAL 
REACTOR SERVICES ARE AVAILABLE THAT ARE SAFE AND AFFORDABLE TO BOTH CONSTRUCT AND OPERATE WHEN COMPARED TO 
COMPETING, ALTERNATIVE SOURCES OF ENERGY IN THE NEAR- AND MID-TERM. THESE DESIGNS ARE EXPECTED TO PROVIDE 
SIGNIFICANT IMPROVEMENTS IN SAFETY, SECURITY, ECONOMICS, AND ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACTS OVER CURRENT NUCLEAR POWER 
PLANT DESIGNS.

THIS FUNDING IS ON A PARTNERSHIP INTERMEDIARY AGREEMENT. 
ENTITIES WORKING TO BRING NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY TO MARKET ENCOUNTER MANY QUESTIONS AND FACE INCREDIBLE UNCERTAINTY AS THEY SEEK TO DEMONSTRATE AND COMMERCIALIZE. IN MANY CASES, SOLUTIONS TO THESE CHALLENGES EXIST, BUT IT IS NOT ALWAYS EASY TO MAKE THE RIGHT CONNECTIONS OR HAVE THE NECESSARY RESOURCES TO ACCESS. THE VOUCHER PROGRAM SEEKS TO TIE THESE DISCRETE PROBLEMS AND SOLUTIONS TOGETHER BY CONNECTING U.S. ENTREPRENEURS, BUSINESSES, AND OTHER PARTNER STAKEHOLDERS WITH VOUCHER PROVIDERS TO ASSIST WITH OVERCOMING ADOPTION BARRIERS THROUGH TARGETED VOUCHER PROJECTS. SPECIFICALLY, THIS VOUCHER OPPORTUNITY  (VO-9) WILL SUPPORT FEASIBILITY STUDIES TO ACCELERATE DEMONSTRATION AND DEPLOYMENT OF PROMISING INDUSTRIAL DECARBONIZATION TECHNOLOGIES TO BENEFIT MANUFACTURERS AND INDUSTRIAL FACILITY OWNER/OPERATORS (WITH AN EMPHASIS ON SMALL AND MEDIUM-SIZED MANUFACTURERS) AS WELL AS TECHNOLOGY FIRMS WORKING TO BRING NEW DECARBONIZATION SOLUTIONS TO MARKET.
MANAGEMENT AND OPERATIONS OF THE INL
